MOVE_ENGINE_FORWARD_UP_TO_NUMBER_OF_BUIL: Requires a private building in the woods (a rare objective/building path); the handler is a one-line wrapper over the shared engine-move code covered by the other MOVE_ENGINE_* tests.
USE_ADJACENT_BUILDING: Requires the player's last activated location to have an adjacent placed building and a legal UseAdjacentBuilding action; the adjacent-location and building-action plumbing is covered indirectly by the building/activation fixtures.
UPGRADE_STATION_TOWN: Rails to the North only: requires a branchlet placed on a station town (spaces 40/41) and the town's station still un-upgraded; the station-upgrade path itself is covered by UPGRADE_STATION.
